brief:
Israeli security and intelligence assessments are being revised following investigation findings that the Omani co-pilot acted as a "lone operative" without direct organizational direction, the Ma'an wire agency reported.

Questioning of the suspect clarified that the operation was not coordinated by an external group, prompting officials to recalibrate their threat evaluations based on the new understanding of how the act was carried out.
